comments.content: This manual lookup fails on Windows for the default `sshCommand` value (`"ssh"`), because the executable is normally `ssh.exe` and `File.Exists(path\ssh)` does not apply `PATHEXT`/`.exe` resolution like command discovery or process creation does. SDK hosts without a TLS runspace will therefore report `CommandNotFoundException` even when OpenSSH is on `PATH`. Please emulate Windows executable-extension resolution (for example by probing `PATHEXT`) during this fallback.
